name: Metformin

lead: Metformin is a first-line oral drug for type 2 diabetes, with decades of safety data. It is available by prescription.

It is discussed in longevity circles because of observational links to lower mortality and cancer rates in diabetics. Whether it slows aging in healthy people is unproven, and recent reviews express skepticism.

paras: Metformin reduces hepatic glucose production and improves insulin sensitivity, partly through AMPK activation and mitochondrial complex I inhibition, with downstream effects on mTOR signaling.

Common side effects are gastrointestinal upset and vitamin B12 deficiency with long-term use; rare lactic acidosis occurs mainly with kidney impairment. Some evidence suggests it may blunt exercise adaptations. Prescription-only; off-label use for aging is not approved.
